title: Foundation Update Payload
description: The structured output returned by the AI extraction node in Step 2. Contains what was learned this round as discrete update records. Does NOT rewrite the full story_foundation_pack — the merge Code node handles that.

round_label.description: Human-readable label for this round, e.g. 'Pass 1 - Concept and premise'.

source_type.description: Format of the raw input that was processed.

handoff_date.description: Date of the interview session, ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

summary.description: Plain-language summary of what was learned this round: what is now clear, what remains uncertain, and what still needs answers.

updates.description: Discrete update records — one per field that was addressed this round. The merge Code node applies these to the story_foundation_pack.

section.description: Which section of the story_foundation_pack this update targets.

field.description: The specific field within that section. See field reference below.

value.description: The extracted value. String for most fields. Array of strings for list fields (themes, must_avoid, world_rules, etc.). Null only if the author explicitly stated something is absent.

status.description: confirmed: author stated this clearly and directly. tentative: author hedged or expressed uncertainty. superseded: author explicitly revised a prior statement — include the new value here.

source_quote.description: The line or close paraphrase from the interview that supports this update. Used for debugging and merge audit. Leave empty string if not applicable.

notes.description: Optional model note: 'author sounded uncertain', 'revised from earlier version', 'needs follow-up', etc.

open_questions.description: Unresolved questions identified this round. The merge node adds these to the pack's open_questions list.

reason.description: One sentence explaining why this question matters for the project.

contradictions.description: Conflicts between what was said this round and what is already in the pack. The merge node logs these and does NOT auto-resolve them. Author must resolve before the field can be updated.

earlier_value.description: The current confirmed value in the pack.

new_value.description: The conflicting value from this round.

description.description: Plain explanation of why these conflict.

author_notes.description: Preferences, constraints, and non-negotiables the author mentioned. These map to the author_preferences section of the pack.

completeness_hints.description: The model's read on overall readiness. These are hints only — the merge Code node computes authoritative completeness_status using defined rules.

ready_for_outline.description: Model's assessment of whether the pack is probably ready for outlining.

priority_gaps.description: Plain-language descriptions of the most important missing pieces. Max 5.

field_reference.description: Field names by section. These are the canonical field identifiers used in the 'field' property of each update record.
